title: Siman 395
section: The Matter of the Opposition Against Him

segments.he: אָמַראִם לֹא נִמְצָא מְפרָשׁ בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בְּפֵרוּשׁ שֶׁאָסוּר לוֹמַר גִּירָא
segments.en: (4.) I heard from Rabbi Yudl a report of matters he heard from Rabbainu o.b.m. He answered and said: "Our father Abraham also had great sufferings from incidents like these" — meaning like the incidents and sufferings that pass upon him. For our father Abraham also drew close young people to Hashem Yisburach — for he was converting converts as is known [Bereishis Rabbah 39].
